messages:
Dana (PM): dropped prototype for "compact capacity row" — min/max, burst badge, SLO slider. target: scannable list actions without opening the modal. Rafi (Designer): propose a tiny "impact" stat next to burst (e.g. ~+30ms est.) with a chevron for details; keep it subtle so rows stay single-line. Eun (Frontend): hover-only details are inaccessible. need keyboard-expand and aria-describedby. also burst badge color fails AA on dark theme. Harper (SRE): any numbers must be model-aware and clearly estimated. suggest: "~+30ms (est.)" and a tooltip "Estimate from recent traces for selected model". Dedicated customers can see exact headroom behind a flag. Dana (PM): copy option: "Burst available" vs "Burst headroom" — which reads clearer in tight space? Rafi (Designer): lean "Burst available". add sr-only text: "Burst available, estimated latency impact and cost" for screen readers. Eun (Frontend): warning behavior: when burst == 0 show inline alert: "No burst available — requests may queue" with action "Pick pool with burst". use role=alert and ensure CTA is tabbable/focusable. snippet: ```
No burst available — requests may queue
``` Harper (SRE): ops-bot please create a flag ticket so Dedicated customers see exact headroom values. ops-bot: created INF-5700 (burst-row-exact-flag) assigned to @Harper :white_check_mark: Rafi (Designer): layout nit: min/max steppers crowd the SLO slider on narrow widths. suggestion: collapse steppers into a compact inline control when width < 420px and expand on focus. Dana (PM): SLO presets? research favored quick chips + free edit. propose chips Low/Medium/High that the slider snaps to but remains editable. default to Medium. show preset name in aria-valuetext. Eun (Frontend): implementation notes: slider snaps to presets, arrows nudge by 1 unit, announce numeric changes via aria-live, respect prefers-reduced-motion, and ensure aria-valuetext reads both percent and preset name when snapped. Dana (PM): can Harper/Eun add rough effort estimates to INF-5700 by EOD? i'll attach the mock. thanks! Harper (SRE): will add ETA by 5pm. Eun (Frontend): will add frontend tasks and prototype notes. Dana (PM): closing loop — aiming to land this in the next sprint if estimates look good :thumbsup:
